body.t: Generate random coordinates using equal-area sampling on the sphere, with the available land or country filters. Longitude is sampled uniformly and latitude is sampled through its sine so the generator does not overrepresent the polar regions. Record the input and mode with any exported or reported result.

Repeat an unrestricted global sample several times. The coordinates should vary and may fall in oceans. Choosing a land filter changes the eligible area; it does not guarantee a road, settlement or safe destination at the resulting point.
